reply_text:
I couldn't set up the every-morning digest, and I posted two DMs to Kwame that need a correction.

My first DM said I had no scheduler. That was wrong: I have a scheduler tool, but I didn't check it before claiming otherwise. My second DM corrects that. Scheduled jobs here save their output locally and don't post back to the DM, so a 09:00 digest would never reach Kwame. I didn't create any job.

Kwame can still ask me in the DM for a "Coastal team digest" on demand. I'm a member of #coastal-team, so I can read it for him then. The DM thread now holds both messages, so he may want a clearer note from you.
